correctness.rationale: The complete multipartite Laplacian acts by degree N-s_i on within-part contrasts and N on part-constant zero-global-mean vectors. Its explicit dipole solution yields all absolute transfer coefficients, including the required nonnegative mixed differences. Summing their multiplicities produces the stated F_N formula. The maximum norm is the maximum row sum and is achieved by a sign vector. Strictly decreasing discrete differences of F_N prove the global maximizing pair, with exactly computed small-N ties. Independent exact rational Laplacian inversions verify 87 graph profiles on N<=9 and the extremizers for every N<=25. No finite search is used as proof for all N.

value.rationale: The exact sensitivity amplification of electrical least-squares edge gradients is a natural operational invariant, not an arbitrary slice. This gives a full infinite-family formula, attainable signs, and all N-vertex extremizing multipartite network structures. The uniquely tripartite N=5 maximizer and N=7 tie are substantive boundary phenomena; balanced bipartite graphs become unique optimizers from N=8 and the envelope converges sharply to 3.
